stemMarkdown: A thief driving at 30 km/h gets a head start of 2 hours. A police car then sets off along the same road at 40 km/h. How many hours does the police car take to catch the thief? (Round to 4 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: In 2 hours the thief covers $30 \times 2 = 60$ km. The police close that gap at $40 - 30 = 10$ km/h, taking $\dfrac{60}{10} = 6.0$ hours.
